messages:
alex: Quick sync — need to lock the final GA surface for the inference product. SLA, docs, support runbooks, monitoring, pricing all need owners and green checks by EOD tomorrow.

morgan: For SLA we'll aim for 99.9% uptime and 150ms p50 for hosted API across small model profiles. Is that acceptable to eng and SRE?

sam: 99.9% uptime is fine but p50 depends on model family. Should say p50 <= 150ms for routes with small context; add exception for large context (>4k) and GPU-backed heavy models.

jeff: Agree. SRE can sign off on 99.9% + latency SLOs split by profile. Need alerting plan: page on P1 for availability, P2 for latency regressions. Draft alert rule:
```
alert: RedwoodAPIHighLatency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 0.15
for: 5m
labels: severity=page
``` 
I'll post to monitoring channel after updates.

tanya: Docs checklist: GA runbook, quickstart, migration notes for Dedicated/Private, API examples for streaming + function-call, and a troubleshooting section. I need doc owners for each page.

lisa: Support readiness: playbook for common customer issues (auth errors, quota, model fallback) + triage runbook. We also need escalation knobs for enterprise (SLA credits flow).

morgan: Owners: sam -> SLA validation and load run, jeff -> alerting + runbook, tanya -> docs pages, lisa -> support playbook, alex -> final QA + pricing note. I'll update the spreadsheet.

alex: Pricing: include usage tiers and a dedicated plan note. Finance suggested a reserved-capacity discount band. @jeff can you validate cost assumptions with ops?

jeff: Will run a cost model by tomorrow morning, link to spreadsheet: https://redwood.example/sheets/ga-pricing

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary to 10% at 2034568000, full at 2034571600. Will emit rollout events here.

sam: One more thing — monitoring for model quality regressions. We need an alert when eval-set BLEU/ROUGE/embedding drift exceeds threshold. @tanya can we add a section in docs for quality guardrails?

tanya: Yes. I'll add an 'evaluator' subsection with examples and thresholds. Need sample evals from research.

alex: Action items recap (assignments):
- sam: SLA validation + load test plan (due 2034600000)
- jeff: Alert rules + cost validation (due 2034580000)
- tanya: Docs + eval section (due 2034583600)
- lisa: Support playbooks + escalation flow (due 2034580000)
- morgan: Update GA checklist + pricing banding (due 2034587200)

morgan: If all owners hit their dates, we can greenlight GA signoff on Friday sync. Any blockers?

lisa: No blockers from support side. I might need one extra SME for Dedicated customer FAQs.

alex: Thanks. If anything slips, flag here. I'll consolidate into the official GA readiness doc: https://redwood.example/docs/ga-runbook

jeff: Posting initial alert rule PR in monitoring repo: https://git.redwood/monitoring/pulls/42 :thumbsup:

morgan: OK closing this thread for now — reopen if new blockers surface :white_check_mark:
